dict.string: Loadout asks System Events whether an app a workflow started has opened its window, and drives that app's window when a step you approved says to. It only ever addresses the process Loadout itself started.
Loadout needs access to projects on your Desktop to run workflows and keep their history.
Loadout needs access to projects in Documents to run workflows and keep their history.
Loadout needs access to projects in Downloads to run workflows and keep their history.
